nodes.text:
Here's a 🧵 on what we should know about hMPV:
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a common yet lesser-known respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms. It’s an important cause of respiratory infections in children, the elderly, & immunocompromised people.
Image courtesy: CC Wiki https://t.co/YUAgj3Cs6N

nodes.author: JhunuDr
nodes.text: The post emphasizes the importance of awareness about #HMPVoutbreak, which is often underdiagnosed and can lead to severe respiratory issues in high-risk groups like children under 5, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
2/ Origins
hMPV, first identified in 2001 in the Netherlands, likely infected humans for decades. It belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family, the same family as RSV and measles. https://t.co/x8BnYWQ5c4

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
3/ Symptoms

hMPV symptoms range from mild to severe:

Cough

Fever

Nasal congestion

Shortness of breath

Severe cases can cause bronchiolitis or pneumonia. https://t.co/Ee3BclPHxc

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
4/ Who’s at Risk?

Children (esp. under 5 years)

Older adults

People with asthma, COPD

Immunocompromised individuals https://t.co/2E9Ee6FzcW

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
5/ Transmission
hMPV spreads through:

Respiratory droplets (coughing, sneezing)

Contact with contaminated surfaces

Close person-to-person contact

It peaks in late winter and early spring. https://t.co/f5QJQsSJdj

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
6/ Diagnosis
hMPV is often misdiagnosed as a cold, flu, or RSV. Accurate diagnosis requires:

PCR tests

Nasal/throat swabs https://t.co/pkzfj2fG1Y

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
7/ Treatment
No specific antiviral exists for hMPV. Treatment focuses on symptom relief:

Hydration

Fever reduction 

Severe cases: Oxygen therapy or hospitalization https://t.co/MzuFCXliEV

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
8/ Prevention

Handwashing

Avoiding close contact with sick people

Disinfecting surfaces

Covering coughs/sneezes

No vaccine exists yet, but research is ongoing. https://t.co/Ffa7cV1nyl

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
9/ Public Health Impact
hMPV causes up to 15% of respiratory hospitalizations in kids under 5. It’s a significant contributor to global respiratory illness. https://t.co/PNl153ivXB

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
10/ Recent Findings
hMPV cases spiked post-pandemic, possibly due to reduced immunity from masking/social distancing. Surveillance is critical. https://t.co/NlYpzT07cp

nodes.author: CerebralWizard
nodes.text:
11/ Final Thoughts
hMPV may not grab headlines like RSV or flu, but it’s a formidable virus that deserves awareness. Knowing the signs and taking precautions can save lives.

Let’s stay informed and vigilant! 💡 https://t.co/gT0NPEQRu2
